short_name: generation excluding rooftop and storage denominator
basis: Authored convention matching the emissions overlay
justification: Rooftop output never crosses the NEM and storage and DSP net generation is a small negative loss term, so the remainder is the closest proxy the outlook offers for grid-supplied energy.

short_name: dollar year converted by the ABS All groups CPI
basis: ABS CPI (S003), the index AEMO names (S004)
justification: AEMO's costs are real July 2023 dollars and the campaign's real 30 June 2025 dollars; July 2023 is taken as the June quarter 2023 index, and the September quarter would lower the factor from 1.0598 to 1.047.

short_name: cost classes the campaign does not model
basis: Authored from the campaign's cost scope
justification: The campaign carries no retirement, system security or distribution cost, so those classes are left out; flow path, REZ, and DSP and unserved energy costs stay in.
value: Retirement; system security; distribution capital; distribution O&M

justification: The campaign divides by the load it serves, AEMO operational demand; 0.97 is the demand plan's placeholder for storage charging and auxiliary load between generation and operational demand, not an AEMO figure.
used_for: The common-basis cost denominator and operational_demand_twh
key: Operational demand over generation excluding rooftop and storage
